desc:
✨ Dive into the iconic Roleplay Universe brought to you by Kavra 💜, previously called Kavra's Roleplay Area. ✨

🌎 Explore 17 AMAZING WORLDS perfect for endless RP scenarios. 
👽 Interact with our imaginative players and NPCs. 
👤 Make new friends and race them on the leaderboards.
💎 Checkout the large collection of Passes we have to offer, they're fun!
🏆 Collect Badges by finding characters hidden throughout the worlds and completing tasks.

👏 HAVE FUN, the possibilities are endless and be kind. 🤩
